mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.15 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.15pp in a month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand growth, which elevates corporate profit outlooks and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, the market prices in an imminent monetary policy response, leading to lower discount rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and services output, which strengthens corporate revenue growth expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by >0.2% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% indicates accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly job growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 positions, the labor market strength signals robust consumer spending and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
